narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Prediction -> Action -> Humorous Retraction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic gaming reaction clip where the creator humorously mocks his own failed prediction. He initially asserts that players using a specific character (Raz) are usually unskilled, but when the player on screen performs well, he hilariously tries to change his statement to blame a different character (Yaya) for the performance.
